description:
Reefer payload.

Source: `reeferPayload` schema in the DCSA Event Domain (v3.1.0).

eventDateTime.description: The local date and time when the event took place (or will take place). Format: ISO 8601 date-time.

eventClassifierCode.description:
Code for the event classifier.

Note: allowed values depend on event type. Some event categories in the upstream spec constrain this to a subset (e.g. Shipment/IoT/Reefer are always ACT).

measurements.description: Measured reefer values (conditioned by event type).

setpoints.description: Reefer setpoint values (conditioned by event type).

geoLocation.description:
Geo location.

Kept as unknown since the authoritative schema references LOCATION_DOMAIN types.
